ecopedia.summary: For server admins: Rabotnik settings and chat commands.
ecopedia.section: Rabotnik's settings are saved in Configs/Rabotnik.eco and can be edited in the server UI. Each setting has a description there. The other Rabotnik pages describe the default behavior. The main settings are:
- TickSeconds (30): seconds between Rabotnik updates. - MaxRabotniksPerTick (50): how many Rabotniks one update handles. Larger populations take turns.

- RentBudgetHours (24): hours of rent a Rabotnik needs before it moves in, and keeps in reserve when it buys tools. - LowFundsWarningHours (12): when to warn the owner about rent money. 0 turns the warning off. - EatBelowCalories (2000): when a Rabotnik eats. - BuyFoodFromShops (on): Rabotniks buy food when their Logbook has none. - NotifyOwners (on): chat messages to Logbook owners.

- RequirePayCoversFood (on) and MinPayToFoodRatio (1): skip work that pays less than its food costs. - MaxLaborActionsPerTick (50): a safety cap on labor per update. - HaulContracts and HarvestContracts (on): which contracts Rabotniks take. HarvestTrees (on) and MaxTreeLogs (200) control tree felling. BuyHarvestTools (on) lets Rabotniks buy their own tools. - HaulItemsPerTick (40), HarvestPlantsPerTick (20) and ChopSwingsPerTick (40): work per update. CaloriesPerItemHauled (5) and CaloriesPerPlantHarvested (10): calories per unit of work. - ContractTimeSafety (0.5): the largest share of a contract's time limit a Rabotnik's estimated work may take.

- GiveReputation (on): master switch, with separate switches for contracts, work parties and food. GenerousPayRatio (2) and GoodFoodWageRatio (3) set what counts as generous pay and cheap food. - NegativeReputation (off): Rabotniks also take reputation away for stingy pay and overpriced food. - MaxReputationPerPlayerPerDay (5), ReputationCooldownDays (1), RespectVanillaReputationLimits (on), AnnounceReputation (on) and ReputationFromOwnRabotniks (off). - CulturePerXpRate (0.05): culture per point of experience rate, capped by FoodXpCultureCap and HousingXpCultureCap, and scaled by ReputationCultureBonus. - MarkRabotniksAbandoned (on): put Rabotniks in the Abandoned demographic. - RabotniksVote (on) and VoteBeforeDeadlineMinutes (60): voting.

- /rabotnik list: every Logbook, its Rabotnik and what it is doing. - /rabotnik info NAME: the full status of one Rabotnik. Part of the name is enough. - /rabotnik tick: update every Rabotnik now. - /rabotnik perf: time one update of every Rabotnik. - /rabotnik perfspawn COUNT and /rabotnik perfclear: place, then remove, test Logbooks for performance testing.
